written_by: Claude Code, for Ryan Saleh to check
notes: Mathematics for Explore (spec 21), batch 2. Every name and description is in Stackd's own words; nothing is copied from UC's page. C-ID numbers, the template number and revision, the degree name, the unit totals and the campus major names are copied exactly. UC pathway: the Mathematics Transfer Pathway page on admission.universityofcalifornia.edu (it states no term or year; academic_year is the year it was checked). TMC: template #2001, the PDF in source_url. An option with no C-ID number has an empty c_id, which needs the migration 20261031120000_explore_option_no_c_id.sql before this file can be imported. Topics in both pathways (Counts for both): calculus-single, calculus-multi. Differential equations and linear algebra aren't shared even though both sides ask for them: UC has two rows, the template one row, because it allows one combined course (MATH 910S, 5 units), and the units can't be split between two rows without changing the template's total. The descriptions point at each other. Check every row against its source, delete each todo once confirmed, fill in retrieved_at on both pathways, then run: npm run import -- data/raw/explore/mathematics.json --dry-run
